facts.fact: 章首：光球夜被尖叫打断——Gerrick 整好她的裙摆护她于树干之间扫视围墙
facts.anchor: Gerrick placed her on the ground and ran his hands over her, quickly fixing her dress.

facts.fact: 街上：血浸雪地怪物分食尸体——长角巨兽拖妓女出妓院扒衣
facts.anchor: Blood soaked the snow covered ground while creatures, more beast than man, feasted upon the bodies of the fallen.

facts.fact: Gerrick 拒先找其他人——"怪物们要找的只有一个人，就是你"
facts.anchor: “There is only one person they are looking for, and that person is you.”

facts.fact: Nelveen/Quentin 敲墙呼救入门——急告 Rayner 和 Lucas 被抓走；空屋
facts.anchor: “Andra, they took Rayner and Lucas,” Nelveen frantically murmured.

facts.fact: Nelveen 读心战果：逐个挖黑施法者——每人的坑位置全不一样
facts.anchor: “They each had a different location for the pit. Every single one of them was different.”

facts.fact: 假记忆结论：Vasara 植入假情报藏真位置——"不可能及时找到了"（踢椅子）
facts.anchor: “To keep the real location of the pit hidden,” Gerrick finished across the room. “We’ll never find it in time.”

facts.fact: 数字：距冬至屠杀只剩六天——坑位置归零计划崩塌她跪倒在地
facts.anchor: They had only six days until Vasara would begin killing the innocents of the Southern Woods

facts.fact: 她拍板直奔东北海岸——Gerrick 拒绝"送你去被宰"；她嘶喊"她抓了他们俩"
关系确认：对他的怨憎不知何时变质——他每次都选择留下
facts.anchor: Somewhere along the way, the bitter loathing she felt for this man had morphed into something else entirely

facts.fact: 越墙：深吻即推——推过 Nelveen 幻术墙自己留下断后；如坠冰河
facts.anchor: Gerrick grabbed Andra’s face and kissed her deep and quick before shoving her through the wall.

facts.fact: Nelveen 力竭：面如死灰双眼霜灰——能量渗入幻术；"说好一起活着"
facts.anchor: Her skin was ashen, eyes turning a frosty gray as her remaining energy seeped from her body and into the enchantment

facts.fact: 章末：一只吃尸体的怪物+另一只的喉音就在她正后方
facts.anchor: And it was right behind Andra.
